270 | def get_ptset_centroids(v_layer, grid_layer, id_field_name = 'ID',nNeighbors = 3):
271 |     """
272 |     Description
273 |     ----------
274 |     From a selection of points in v_layer, returns
275 |     a dict of tuple (nrow, ncol) in grid_layer
276 |     returns
277 | 
278 |     Parameters
279 |     ----------
280 |     v_layer : Vector layer containing the observation points.
281 |              Only selected points are considered
282 |     grid_layer : Qgridder grid layer
283 |     id_field_name : Column in v_layer containing points ID
284 |                   which will be used in the output dictionary
285 |     nNeighbors : number of neighboring grid cells to fetch
286 | 
287 |     Returns
288 |     -------
289 | 
290 |     {'ID1':(nrow1, ncol1), 'ID2':(nrow2, ncol2), ... }
291 | 
292 |     Examples
293 |     --------
294 |     >>>
295 |     """
296 | 
297 |     # v_layer : vector layer of points with a selection of point
298 |     # grid_layer : the grid vector Layer
299 |     # field_name : the attribute field of v_layer containing feature identificator
300 |     # nNeighbors : number of neighboring cells to fetch for each point
301 | 
302 |     # check that grid_layer is a grid
303 |     try :
304 |         res = rgrid_numbering(grid_layer)
305 |         if res == False:
306 |             print("The grid layer does not seem to be valid")
307 |             return(False)
308 |     except :
309 |         return(False)
310 | 
311 |     # -- create temporary layer of cell centroids
312 |     # init layer type (point) and crs
313 |     cLayerCrs = grid_layer.crs().authid()
314 |     # create layer
315 |     cLayer = QgsVectorLayer("Point?crs=" + cLayerCrs, "temp_centroids", "memory")
316 |     cProvider = cLayer.dataProvider()
317 |     cProvider.addAttributes( grid_layer.dataProvider().fields().toList() )
318 | 
319 |     # fill layer with centroids
320 |     feat_centroids = []
321 |     for cell in grid_layer.getFeatures():
322 |         feat = QgsFeature()
323 |         geom = cell.geometry().centroid()
324 |         feat.setAttributes( cell.attributes() )
325 |         feat.setGeometry( QgsGeometry(geom) )
326 |         feat_centroids.append(feat)
327 | 
328 |     cProvider.addFeatures( feat_centroids )
329 | 
330 |     # -- Create and fill spatial Index
331 |     cLayerIndex = QgsSpatialIndex(cLayer.getFeatures())
332 | 
333 |     # init distance tool
334 |     d = QgsDistanceArea()
335 | 
336 |     # PtsetCentroids : { pointIDValue:[ (nrow, ncol, dist), ... ] }
337 |     PtsetCentroids = {}
338 | 
339 |    # check that the selection in v_layer is not empty
340 |     selected_feature_ids = v_layer.selectedFeatureIds()
341 |     if len(selected_feature_ids) == 0:
342 |         print("Empty selection, all features considered")
343 |         features = v_layer.getFeatures()
344 |     else :
345 |         print("Only selected features will be considered")
346 |         features = v_layer.selectedFeatures()
347 | 
348 |     # iterate over selected points, find neighbors, fill pointCentroids dictionary
349 |     for selectedPoint in features:
350 |         neighborsIds = cLayerIndex.nearestNeighbor(selectedPoint.geometry().asPoint(), nNeighbors)
351 |         neighborsData = []
352 |         # iterate over neighbors
353 |         for neighborId in neighborsIds:
354 |             neighborFeat = QgsFeature()
355 |             cProvider.getFeatures( QgsFeatureRequest().setFilterFid( neighborId ) ).nextFeature( neighborFeat )
356 |             row = neighborFeat['ROW']
357 |             col = neighborFeat['COL']
358 |             dist = d.measureLine( neighborFeat.geometry().asPoint(), selectedPoint.geometry().asPoint() )
359 |             neighborsData.append( (row, col, dist) )
360 |         PtsetCentroids[selectedPoint[id_field_name]] = neighborsData
361 | 
362 |     return(PtsetCentroids)
